englishTranslation: Rice with braised pork and eggs
atAGlance: Cơm thịt kho trứng is rice with caramel-braised pork and egg, usually in a salty-sweet fish-sauce braise. The rice is there to soak up the dark sauce.
whatItIs: Cơm thịt kho trứng is rice with pork belly or pork pieces braised with eggs in coconut-water fish-sauce caramel. It is sweet-salty, homey, and made for spooning over rice.
howToEnjoy: Break the egg into the rice, spoon a little braising liquid over the grains, and balance the richness with pickles or greens if they come with the plate.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm thịt kho trứng when you want a homestyle pork-and-egg rice plate. Ask for extra rice or more egg if you want the sweet-salty braise to go further.
worthKnowing: Thịt kho trứng is strongly tied to Vietnamese home cooking and Tết memories, so it can feel more like family food than street food.
goodToKnow: This is the rice-plate version of a family-style braise. Ask for more rice rather than more sauce if the flavor is too intense.
travelerCaution: Contains pork, egg, and fish sauce.
